entries.summary: The chair of the New Carlsberg Foundation also chairs the Glyptotek's board. The foundation said so in August 2019 when the Carlsberg Foundation appointed Christine Buhl Andersen, then the museum's director, as its chair.

entries.summary: Jacob Rothschild became chairman of the National Gallery's trustees in 1985 and attended Queen Elizabeth II when she opened the Sainsbury Wing in July 1991.
entries.evidence: his time as chairman of its trustees. He took up the role in 1985

entries.summary: Hannah Rothschild chaired the National Gallery's trustees, the first woman to do so, until September 2019. The director Gabriele Finaldi thanked her for her "commitment and generosity".
entries.evidence: Hannah Rothschild CBE will step down as Chair of Trustees in September

entries.summary: Lord Rothschild sat on the Courtauld's Governing Board from June 2002 to July 2007. The Courtauld's tribute in 2024 called him "tremendously generous" to it.
entries.evidence: a member of its Governing Board from 19 June 2002 to 12 July 2007

entries.summary: The campaign group Scientist Rebellion said the museum "has a greenwashing problem" and named Citibank among its corporate members, banks that "invest heavily in fossil fuels".
entries.evidence: The American Museum of Natural History has a greenwashing problem

entries.summary: Francesca Lavazza was elected to the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation's Board of Trustees. She said in March 2017 that the invitation came "after two years of exhibition partnerships".
entries.evidence: After two years of exhibition partnerships, I was invited to join the Board of Trustees
